description: Playwright MCP Server — browser automation for navigating pages, taking screenshots, and extracting data

steps: Install Playwright browsers: npx playwright install chromium
Configure in your MCP client settings
setup.notes: Runs in headless mode by default. Use the 'headed' flag for debugging. Docker images available for CI/CD.

use_cases: Navigate websites and extract structured data
Take screenshots of pages for visual verification
Fill and submit forms for testing
Perform end-to-end testing with AI assistance

docker_alternative.description: For environment isolation, use the Docker image
